programmes.d: After welcoming newlywed sous chef Andi Van Willigan back to “Hell's Kitchen,” Chef Ramsay requests that both teams make six dishes each.
After treating the contestants to a performance by guitarist Steve Vai, Chef Ramsay gives them a new five-dish challenge.
The chefs cook bison with international flair. The winners meet some animal actors while the losers make bread and butter from scratch.
Each team has thirty minutes to create vegetarian, sweet, meat and seafood breakfast dishes. The winners take a private plane to Palm Springs.
The teams have only five minutes to gather ingredients for a rack of lamb, sea bass and chicken. The chefs take turns cooking before being replaced by a teammate.
The remaining chefs compete in the annual blind taste test. The winners go on a shopping spree at Roland Products while the losers prepare the foul-smelling durian fruit for a dessert.
Confined to straitjackets, the contestants must help their visiting loved ones re-create Chef Ramsay's branzino dish.
At Animo Venice Charter High School, Ramsay surprises the final five with high school photos of themselves. Each chef must cook a unique dish in forty minutes.
The contestants have forty minutes to cook a steak and two sides. The winner dines at Beverly Hills' CUT while the losers clean the truck and motorbikes used to drive to Las Vegas.
On the USS Iowa, the final two chefs must create three main entrées, one cold appetizer and one hot appetizer. The winner gets first pick in creating a team from eliminated chefs.
The chefs prepare their signature dishes and compete in the first team challenge.
The teams compete in the first "Hell's Kitchen" Grand Prix crepe-making challenge.
The teams are challenged to cook eight ostrich dishes, using the most popular ostrich meats, in forty minutes.
The chefs have to team up for a surf and turf protein relay.
After a shocking elimination, both teams must regroup and chart a new course.
The remaining chefs use cookbooks from Gordon's library to spell out the ingredients they want to use for their next challenge.
The chefs have forty minutes to create their own interpretations of six southern dishes.

Chef Ramsay informs the teams that Hell's Kitchen will be hosting the International Ballroom Invitational and that they will prepare a special menu for the event.
The remaining chefs prepare for their next challenge: a blind taste test during which each team must determine the taste of pureed baby foods.
The chefs are challenged to make sliders for three burger aficionados.
The chefs pair up for a taste challenge in which the winners receive Vitamix blenders and a special trapeze lesson on the Santa Monica Pier.
The chefs pair up for a challenge in which they must combine two countries' flavors to impress the guest judge, Roy Yamaguchi.
Chef Ramsay shakes things up and introduces a series of three challenges that will determine the recipients of black jackets.
The remaining chefs are challenged to create their dishes with only six ingredients.
